headline: BTG Pactual adds Pix support for loyalty program benefit redemptions
summary: BTG Pactual cardholders can now use loyalty program benefits for tax payments, bill settlements, and Pix transfers directly within the mobile application.
why: BTG Pactual is a major Latin American investment bank expanding its digital retail banking features and loyalty utility.

impacts.name: Banco BTG Pactual SA
impacts.why: Enhanced digital payment features improve customer engagement and platform stickiness for retail banking clients.
